product: Laundry bar soap, 200g, palm kernel oil

followUp.question: Laundry or bathing soap?
followUp.hint: Laundry bars need a harder, cheaper formula; bathing bars need milder oils, fragrance and NAFDAC cosmetic registration.

analysis.summary: A hard laundry bar made from palm kernel oil and caustic soda by the semi-boiled frame method, cut, stamped and wrapped in 200g bars.

materials.name: Palm kernel oil
materials.role: Primary material. Its 45 to 55% lauric acid gives a hard bar and a dense lather.
materials.source: Oil palm estates in Edo and the south east, delivered in drums or 25 L kegs

materials.name: Caustic soda
materials.role: Turns the oil into soap. 99% flakes or pearls, dissolved in water as lye.
materials.source: Ojota Chemical Market, Lagos. Mostly imported.

materials.name: Sodium silicate
materials.role: Builder and hardener. Cheaper than oil and helps cleaning in hard water.

materials.name: Wrappers and cartons
materials.role: Packaging. Printed wrapper per bar, 24 bars per carton.

process.title: Melt the oil
process.detail: Warm palm kernel oil to about 45°C so it is fully liquid and even.

process.title: Make the lye
process.detail: Dissolve caustic soda in water to about a 30% solution, in a steel tank. It gets hot: let it cool before use. Gloves, goggles and ventilation are required.

process.title: Mix and saponify
process.detail: Add the lye to the oil in the mixer and stir until it thickens to trace. Add sodium silicate, fragrance and colour.

process.title: Pour into frames
process.detail: Pour into lined frame moulds and leave 24 to 48 hours to set.

process.title: Cure
process.detail: Cut into slabs and cure 7 to 14 days so the reaction finishes and water evaporates. The bar gets harder and milder.

process.title: Cut and stamp
process.detail: Cut slabs into 200g bars and stamp the brand name. A plodder can replace frames for a denser, uniform bar.

process.title: Wrap and carton
process.detail: Wrap each bar, pack 24 to a carton, and code the batch.

context: Retail soap and detergents (HS 3401.11.10.00 to 3402.90.00.00) are on Nigeria's import prohibition list, confirmed in the revised list of April 2026. Local makers compete with local brands, not imports.
Nigeria still imported 35,811 tonnes of soap noodles, the semi-finished base many factories use, in 2022, worth over ₦17 billion. RMRDC is pushing makers to use local palm and coconut oil instead.
Palm kernel oil is made from the same oil palm Nigeria grows across the south, so the main material is local. Caustic soda is mostly imported.
A small workshop kit costs $6,000 to $15,000 (about ₦8m to ₦21m at ₦1,390/$), a fraction of a food processing line.
FIIRO in Lagos runs regular laundry soap and black soap production courses.

cost.verdict: Local production is about 9% cheaper than a landed import, and the real benchmark is better still: retail soap can't legally be imported, so you compete with local brands whose 220g laundry bars wholesale around ₦500. At ₦356 a bar the margin is healthy. The swing factor is palm kernel oil, 63% of the cost: ₦1,500/kg in the wet season, ₦2,100/kg in the dry, which moves the bar by about ₦40 either way. With a ₦14m kit and a ₦144 margin, break-even is about 100,000 bars: around 5 months at 20,000 bars a month.
caveats: Caustic soda burns skin and eyes. Train before the first batch, and budget for gloves, goggles and ventilation.
Frame-cast bars cure for 7 to 14 days, so two weeks of stock and cash are always tied up on the shelves.
Caustic soda is mostly imported, so part of the cost still moves with the naira.
Retail soap is on the import prohibition list. The import column is what a legal import would cost; smuggled soap still competes on price.
Equipment prices are listings and supplier ranges, not quotes.

groups.name: Materials
groups.description: Palm kernel oil is most of the cost, so buy it in bulk from estates. Everything else comes from the Ojota chemical market.

suppliers.name: Ojota Chemical Market
suppliers.note: The largest chemical market in West Africa, and where most Lagos soap makers buy their chemicals.

suppliers.name: Fellosfield Chemicals
suppliers.note: Imports caustic soda and other household and industrial chemicals.

suppliers.name: Chimaco Enterprises
suppliers.note: Deals in raw materials for liquid soap, laundry soap, bathing soap and detergent.

suppliers.name: Presco
suppliers.note: One of Nigeria's largest oil palm companies. Ask for palm kernel oil in drums on a weekly schedule.

suppliers.name: Okomu Oil Palm
suppliers.note: Large listed oil palm producer. A second source keeps you running when one estate is short.

suppliers.name: Lagos packaging converters
suppliers.note: Print wrappers with your brand, weight and NAFDAC number.

groups.name: Workshops
groups.description: Who can train you and build or sell you the kit.

suppliers.name: FIIRO
suppliers.note: Federal Institute of Industrial Research runs laundry soap production courses several times a year. Take one before handling caustic soda at scale.

suppliers.name: Soap machine fabricators
suppliers.note: Local fabricators build mixers, cutters and stampers. Plodders are listed at ₦1.8m to ₦5m.

suppliers.name: NIFOR
suppliers.note: Nigerian Institute for Oil Palm Research. Useful for palm kernel oil quality and sourcing contacts.

groups.name: Services
groups.description: Registration, standards and getting bars to market.

suppliers.name: NAFDAC registration
suppliers.note: Required before sale. The MSME pathway has lower fees for small makers.

suppliers.name: SON (MANCAP)
suppliers.note: Standards Organisation of Nigeria certifies locally made products against the national soap standard.

suppliers.name: Oke-Arin market
suppliers.note: Lagos's big provisions wholesale market, where laundry soap moves by the carton.

stats.label: Suggested batch
stats.note: 1 tonne of soap from 625 kg palm kernel oil

steps.title: Train with FIIRO
steps.detail: Take FIIRO's laundry soap course. Safe caustic handling and getting the oil-to-lye ratio right matter more than any machine.

steps.title: Register the product
steps.detail: NAFDAC registration (about ₦41,000 on the MSME band) and SON MANCAP certification run alongside setup.

steps.title: Get the kit
steps.detail: Have a Lagos fabricator build the mixer, frames and cutter. Buy the stamper, scales, PPE and generator.

steps.title: Buy materials
steps.detail: Order 625 kg of palm kernel oil from an estate and 5 bags of caustic soda, silicate and fragrance from Ojota.

steps.title: Mix and pour
steps.detail: Melt the oil, make the lye, mix to trace, add silicate and fragrance, then pour into frames.

steps.title: Cure
steps.detail: Cut into slabs after 48 hours and cure on racks. Start the next batch meanwhile: curing, not mixing, limits output.

steps.title: Cut, stamp, wrap and carton
steps.detail: Cut 5,000 200g bars, stamp, wrap and pack 24 to a carton.

quotes.brief: Weekly supply for a laundry soap workshop in Lagos: 625 kg of palm kernel oil (about 27 × 25 L kegs or drums), 5 × 25 kg bags of 99% caustic soda and 100 kg of sodium silicate. Quote per unit delivered to Lagos, your minimum order, lead time, and whether you can supply every week.
